title: figma-variable-map
description: Read-only census of a Figma library's variable collections: name to key, resolved type, modes, code syntax, and the DTCG token each variable maps to. Lane A (figma-library-census) emits; Lanes B, F read (plan-sheerline-fdde-loop-2026-09-07 section 3.3). Version 1.0; additive thereafter. collections[] is the binding section 3.3 shape. modes and code_syntax are filled from the defining-file read (a consuming file's teamLibrary read returns only name, key, resolved_type per the Ground-truth corrections).

provenance.description: Additive. Where and when the census ran; how modes and code_syntax were sourced.

library_key.description: The publishing library's key; null when the census ran against the defining file alone.

modes.description: Mode names, read from the defining file's collection (a remote teamLibrary read does not return modes).

code_syntax.description: Per-platform code syntax, read in the defining file. Keys are a subset of WEB/ANDROID/iOS. Empty object when none is set.

dtcg_token.description: The served DTCG token this variable maps to (matched by name or code syntax against the served token set); null when no match is found. The census flags, it does not adjudicate a mismatch.
